$comment: The PR lane's platform catalog fixture, served by ./server.mjs to the API of the e2e-app-works-flags-on job (.github/workflows/e2e.yml) through EVER_WORKS_PLATFORM_CATALOG_BASE_URL — ACC-E2E-12's 'Ever platforms from the versioned catalog'. Shape: the published schema (docs/specs/features/app-works/APW-11-app-launcher/catalog-draft/schema/platforms.schema.json) as the API reader enforces it (apps/api/src/app-launcher/platform-catalog.schema.ts); __tests__/server.unit.spec.ts feeds this file to that reader and requires it to be accepted whole. Addresses are RFC 2606 example.com hosts: nothing here resolves to a real service. The seven entries mirror the published catalog's ids, order and statuses (ever-demand is `soon`, so the lane sees one Soon tile), and every entry has a develop address because the lane reads develop; ever-traduora deliberately has no stage address (FR-10).
